[EN] It's an honor to be included in research of this caliber, but that doesn't mean it's easy. Two researchers were killed installing the mana gauges, and many more were injured just trying to get the readouts.
[ES] Es un honor formar parte de una investigación de este calibre, pero eso no significa que sea fácil. Dos investigadores murieron al instalar los medidores de MP, y muchos más resultaron heridos solo al intentar obtener las lecturas.
